nom: La Roche-Posay, Effaclar, Masque Purifiant Désincrustant, Anti-Points Noirs et Anti-Impuretés, Peaux Sensibles et Peaux Grasses à Tendance Acnéique, 100 ml

avis.titre: Bon pour un nettoyage en douceur
avis.texte: Bonjour, Le produit est bien pour les peaux délicates et sensibles, ça se rince bien et donne une sensation de peau fraîchement purifié et propre. Ce que je veux dire, c’est qu’on a pas la sensation d’être ressortis d’une centrale chimique bien que… Je l’aime bien, il est possible que ce produit fasse partie de la bande. Bonne expérience à vous. Bonne journée

L'articolo è arrivato nei tempi previsti. La maschera ha una consistenza cremosa, non ha odori forti, non secca durante il tempo di posa. È pratica da usare, dato che bisogna semplicemente spalmarla e attendere dai 5 ai 10minuti prima di risciacquare. Si risciacquare facilmente. È consigliabile farla due volte a settimana. Io la metto anche solo sul brufolo perchè tende a seccarlo. È un valido prodotto. La consiglio sicuramente
Tengo combo skin, con tendencia al acne, y aparte se irrita y pone roja facilmente, la mascarilla me aclara la piel, no me la deja roja y ayuda con la limpieza facial.

I love this product! I've used a couple of clay masks in the past, but this was the most impressive one I have used so far. It's far move 'noursihing' than the other masks I've had, meaning that my skin visibly looks and feels healthier after I put this on. I've used two times a week in the two weeks I have been using it, and I feel like the mask is doing a good job of keeping my excess sebum in balance. Like any other La Roche-Posay product, this mask has also been infused with their thermal water. As a result of that (and generally the formulation of the product) it did not irritate my skin at all. The product packaging claims that this mask has been tested on "oily, acne-prone skin," which could explain why it feels perfect for my skin.

avis.titre: Leaves My Skin Feeling Clean and Refreshed
avis.texte: This is a great face mask that leaves my skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed without being overly harsh or drying. It is easy to apply and rinse off, and a little goes a long way. Another excellent product from La Roche-Posay!
